name: Codex CLI
args: Read the file {systemPromptPath} completely. It holds your instructions. Then read the file {userPromptPath} and carry out the task it describes. Write files only inside {artifactDirAbs}.
resumeCommand: Read the file {systemPromptPath} completely. It holds your instructions. Then read the file {userPromptPath} and carry out the task it describes. Write files only inside {artifactDirAbs}.
limits: Codex runs in its workspace-write sandbox: it can edit files and run commands inside the workspace, and nothing outside it. Codjiva checks the workspace after every run and discards the result if a file outside its own folder was changed.
installHint: Install the Codex CLI from https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli, then run `codex login`.
